Protests against the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose project in Arunachal Pradesh have escalated. The Chief Minister, Monday, in an open letter said that all concerns of protesters will be addressed.
Episode 1929 looks at the journey of the Siang Dam project, and where things stand. ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta also explains the strategic dimension, and the China factor.
